//! Sample module used by the lint tests.
//! It shows each case the rules must handle.
use std::fmt;

/// item doc fails
pub struct Point<'a> {
    label: &'a str, // trailing fails
}

/* block fails */
fn strings<'a>(input: &'a str) -> Vec<&'a str> {
    let url = "https://example.com/a//b";
    let hash = "# not a comment /* nor this */";
    let raw = r#"he said "// still a string" and /* this */"#;
    let raw2 = r##"a "# b // c"##;
    let ch = '/';
    let lifetime_ok: &'static str = "'a // b";
    vec![input, url, hash, raw, raw2, lifetime_ok]
}

#[allow(dead_code)]
fn allowed() {}

#[expect(unused_variables)]
fn expected() {}

mod inner {
    #![allow(unused)]
}

#[derive(Debug)]
struct Kept;

fn tail() {
    let x = 1; /* inline block fails */
    // line fails
}

macro_rules! suppressed {
    () => {
        #[allow(dead_code)]
        #[derive(Debug)]
        struct Inside;
    };
}
